mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates below 0.5% indicate accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint positive movement of HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in interaction periods).

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (year-over-year > 1.5%) indicates efficient supply chains and rising manufacturing output that boosts corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO year-over-year growth > 1.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (annualized) signals strong economic expansion that increases corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with GDP growth > 2.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Robust monthly payroll growth exceeding 100k jobs signals expanding labor market capacity that increases consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS monthly growth > 100k (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals stagflation risk that compresses profit margins and increases equity volatility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
